facts.fact: FAO says a two-day online coaching on 19 and 20 August 2026 trained technicians of the National Irrigation Institute (INIR) on IPADT, a WaPOR-based remote-sensing dashboard of irrigation performance for the Lower Limpopo schemes (Chokwe, Xai-Xai); the next step is to support INIR in applying it to real management problems.
facts.system: IPADT (Irrigation Performance Assessment and Diagnostic Tool)

systems.platform: WaPOR v3 data dashboard, QGIS and Excel
